category_title: Students with emotional and behavioural disabilities transitioning to mainstream vocational settings
scenario_title: Environmental anxiety triggered by loud noises
minimal_context: Ian is sitting in a noisy classroom and is asked to study his textbook.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your book and start studying the assigned chapter.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I hate studying, and it's way too loud in this room right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to ignore the noise and focus on your work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't! All this noise is making me anxious. I'm not doing this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete this studying task today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said I'm not doing it! Leave me alone! (Slams the book shut and starts loudly calling out and making noises at the desk)
